mission: Phase 2: Integration Layer Design — Backend↔Forge Mapping
description: Full inventory of all 13 forge prototype files at file/screen/sub-component level. Each entry includes sections, mock data arrays with field-by-field mapping, integration readiness labels, builder workspace features (~50 items), and all tweaks panel features.

files.name: FheForge.html
files.description: HTML entry point with boot splash, CDN dependencies (React 18.3.1, ReactDOM, Babel standalone), theme persistence script, and script loading order for all forge files. Routes CSS + JS via script tags with Babel transpilation.

sections.name: Head / Metadata
sections.description: HTML meta tags, title 'FheForge — encrypted DeFi on Arbitrum Sepolia', viewport config, Google Fonts preconnect (Instrument Serif, Newsreader, Public Sans, JetBrains Mono)

sections.name: Theme Persistence Script
sections.description: Synchronous script that reads localStorage 'fheforge:theme' or prefers-color-scheme to set data-theme attribute on <html> before paint, preventing flash

sections.name: Boot Splash
sections.description: Full-viewport boot splash with 'FheForge' wordmark, animated dot, 'booting · cofhe-sdk · 421614' label, auto-removed via MutationObserver when root children mount

sections.name: CDN Dependencies
sections.description: React 18.3.1 (development), ReactDOM 18.3.1 (development), Babel standalone 7.29.0 — all loaded via unpkg with SRI integrity hashes

sections.name: Script Loading Order
sections.description: Loads tweaks-panel.jsx → components.jsx → screens (landing, dashboard, lending, builder-workspace, market, governance, connect-modal) → app.jsx. Order matters: builder-workspace before market.

files.name: theme.css
files.description: Complete design token system and CSS framework for FheForge. Two themes (light/warm-paper, dark/terminal). Covers typography, layout, components, animations, responsive breakpoints, reduced motion.

sections.name: Design Tokens — Light Theme
sections.description: CSS custom properties for light theme: surfaces (paper, paper-2, paper-3), ink colors, signal colors (accent, positive, danger), cipher haze, grain RGBA. Uses OKLCH color space.

sections.name: Design Tokens — Dark Theme
sections.description: CSS custom properties for dark theme: near-mirror of light with darker surfaces, lighter ink, adjusted signal colors. Uses OKLCH color space.

sections.name: Typography System
sections.description: Four font families (serif: Newsreader, display: Instrument Serif, sans: Public Sans, mono: JetBrains Mono). Scale with rem values, display/sectionhead/eyebrow/micro classes.

sections.name: Motion Budget
sections.description: CSS custom properties for animation: --ease (cubic-bezier), --ease-out, --t-feedback (120ms for hover/micro), --t-state (200ms for state changes), --t-enter (400ms for mount)

sections.name: Layout Components
sections.description: Section, shell (max-width 1480px), topbar (sticky, backdrop-filter), master-detail frame (320px list + detail), chips, buttons (default, ghost, accent, sm, lg), cards/blocks, KV rows, cipher display, LTV meter/gauge, canvas, modal, tabstrip, permit stage

sections.name: Builder Canvas CSS
sections.description: Canvas grid background, three SVG edge layers (edges/edges-active/ports), zoom controls, node styling (selected/active/past/cycle/dragging), port circles with hover/active/pending states, drop-active highlight, draw-on animation, edge styles (idle, active, selected, error, warn)

sections.name: Animations & Keyframes
sections.description: nodeIn, fadeIn, edgeDraw, edgeIdleFlow, edgeErrorFlow, cyclePulse, portPulse, pulseDot, orbitDrift, orbitCounter, modalIn, suggestPulse, issuePinPulse, readyPulse, issueToastIn, toastIn, tickerLoop

sections.name: Responsive Breakpoints
sections.description: 980px (grid collapse), 720px (mobile nav, topbar nav hide), 480px (smaller wordmark). Adaptive resize hardening for builder canvas (1279px). Reduced motion media query.

sections.name: Fullscreen Builder Styles
sections.description: Position fixed, z-index 70, hides topbar, forces md-frame to full height with closed list, hides list and rail toggle

files.name: app.jsx
files.description: React root application component with routing between 5 screens (home/portfolio/lend/strategies/governance), wallet context state, permit countdown timer, theme persistence, and tweaks panel integration. Renders TopBar, active Screen, ConnectModal, MobileNav, TweaksPanel.

sections.name: App() — Main Component
sections.description: Root component managing theme state (light/dark/system default), route state, wallet context (connected, address, permitUnlocked, permitSeconds, revealing), connect modal visibility. Renders TopBar, screen, ConnectModal, MobileNav, TweaksPanel.

sections.name: Theme Toggle Logic
sections.description: Reads initial theme from localStorage or system preference, persists changes, updates data-theme on <html>

sections.name: Permit Countdown Timer
sections.description: useEffect-based countdown that decrements permitSeconds every second, auto-locks when expired

sections.name: grantPermit() — Staggered Reveal
sections.description: Connects wallet if not connected, applies staggered cipher reveal delays (50ms per element sorted by top position), sets permitUnlocked=true with 15-minute countdown

sections.name: Route System
sections.description: Simple if/else route switch rendering Landing, Dashboard, Lending, Market, Governance components based on route state

sections.name: Global Error Capture
sections.description: window error event listener that renders error details to root if app fails to mount

sections.name: Webfont FOUT Fix
sections.description: Relayout on document.fonts.ready to prevent FOIT/FOUT flash

files.name: components.jsx
files.description: 15 shared UI components used across all screens. Exported to window for cross-file Babel usage. Covers cipher display, permit chip, wallet chip, theme toggle, asset glyph, LTV gauge, sparkline, tag, stat, master-detail layout, modal, topbar, mobile nav.

sections.name: Cipher
sections.description: Core encrypted-value display component. Shows blurred ciphertext when locked, plaintext when unlocked. Supports sizes: sm/md/lg/xl/xxl. Inline mode. Dim mode. Container-query based auto-shrink for large values. Shows 'encrypted' lock-mark when locked.

sections.name: PermitChip
sections.description: Top-bar indicator showing FHE permit status. Live state shows countdown (MM:SS), warn state shows 'permit · locked'. Clickable to renew/grant.

sections.name: WalletChip
sections.description: Clickable wallet address display with truncated address (0x9f3a…b4a39), chain ID (421614). Opens connect modal on click.

sections.name: ThemeToggle
sections.description: Dark/light theme toggle button with sun/moon SVG icons. Updates data-theme attribute on <html>.

sections.name: AssetGlyph
sections.description: Circular asset icon with first letter of symbol. Pre-defined color swatches for USDC, ETH, WBTC, ARB, GHO, DAI, WETH.

sections.name: LtvGauge
sections.description: Loan-to-value horizontal meter with fill bar, liquidation tick, optional labels. Color transitions from ink → accent → danger as LTV approaches liquidation.

sections.name: Spark
sections.description: Inline sparkline SVG chart. Renders smooth path from array of data points.

sections.name: Tag
sections.description: Status tag/badge with configurable tone: default, accent, positive, danger, ink. Used for status labels throughout the UI.

sections.name: Stat
sections.description: Composable stat display with kicker label, cipher value, optional sub text.

sections.name: MasterDetail
sections.description: Core layout primitive for all product screens. Split-panel with collapsible list rail (320px) and detail body. Supports keyboard shortcuts (⌘B toggle, J/K vim list navigation, Enter click), localStorage collapse persistence, full-bleed detail, detail fullscreen.

sections.name: MDItem
sections.description: List item for md-list-body with optional index, title, subtitle, right content, selected state.

sections.name: MDGroup
sections.description: List group header section label.

sections.name: Modal
sections.description: Modal overlay with backdrop blur, Escape-to-close, click-outside-to-close, scroll lock.

sections.name: TopBar
sections.description: Sticky top navigation bar with wordmark, 5 nav buttons (Home/Portfolio/Lend/Strategies/Governance), theme toggle, network chip (Arb·Sepolia), wallet chip or connect button, permit chip. Responsive: nav hidden at 720px.

sections.name: MobileNav
sections.description: Fixed bottom navigation bar shown only at ≤720px width. 4 buttons (Folio, Lend, Build, Gov).

files.name: screens/landing.jsx
files.description: Landing/home page — full-viewport hero with auto-playing permit demo. No editorial scroll sections. Connect button opens modal; CTAs route into the app. BackgroundOrbits atmospheric SVG, Ticker with scrolling protocol stats.

sections.name: Landing() — Main Screen
sections.description: Full-viewport hero grid (left: headline + CTAs, right: DemoCard). Animated reveal on mount (opacity/transform transition). Cursor-tracking accent glow on hero. Auto-play cipher cycle (6.5s interval) when wallet not connected.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.description: Left side: protocol description ('An encrypted DeFi protocol · Arbitrum Sepolia'), headline ('Borrow, swap, compound – without revealing a number.'), body copy, Connect wallet CTA, secondary Explore strategies CTA, trust indicators (no read access, no transaction without signature)

sections.name: DemoCard
sections.description: Interactive permit demo card showing mock portfolio on the landing page. Auto-plays cipher locked/unlocked cycle (6.5s) when wallet not connected. Shows net value USDC, 24h change, 3 position rows (Supplied 42,084.13 USDC, Borrowed 18,910.00 ETH, In strategies 7,418.94 USDC). Permit lock/live indicator. Grant permit button.

sections.name: Ticker
sections.description: Slow horizontal scrolling ticker (60s loop, seamless via duplicate) showing protocol operational state: block height, gas price, pool TVLs (USDC/ETH/WBTC), encrypted ops count, permit decrypts, active strategies, composer deployments.

fields.name: value

files.name: screens/dashboard.jsx

Right pane: Overview (default) with four stat tiles, LTV gauge card, or detail view for selected item (PositionDetail, StrategyDetail, ActivityDetail). Empty state shown when wallet not connected.

sections.name: Dashboard() — Main Screen
sections.description: MasterDetail with portfolio collapse key. List shows Positions, Strategies, Activity groups. Detail shows Overview or DetailFor. Redirects to DashboardEmpty if wallet not connected.

sections.name: Overview

sections.name: PositionDetail / StrategyDetail / ActivityDetail

sections.name: DashboardEmpty

files.name: screens/lending.jsx
files.description: Lending screen with master-detail layout. Left rail: user's position summary + 5 markets (USDC, ETH, WBTC, ARB, DAI). Right pane: action panel for selected market (Supply/Borrow toggle, amount input, LTV slider, summary card, market info).

sections.name: Lending() — Main Screen
sections.description: MasterDetail with lending collapse key. List shows user position (net supplied, net borrowed, LTV gauge) + 5 markets with AssetGlyph, utilization, TVL, supply/borrow APY. Detail shows LendAction panel for selected asset.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: Asset symbol: USDC, ETH, WBTC, ARB, DAI

sections.name: LendAction
sections.description: Two-column action panel. Left: amount input with quick-select buttons (25%/50%/75%/Max), permit-required banner, LTV slider (borrow only) with gauge and liquidation warning, action button (Connect/Grant/Encrypt & submit). Right: summary card (APY, health after, liq price, gas) + market info card (utilization, TVL, liq threshold, oracle freshness).

files.name: screens/market.jsx
files.description: Strategies marketplace with master-detail layout. Left rail: user's drafts (persisted in localStorage) + community templates (6 strategies). Right pane: BuilderWorkspace full-bleed canvas for selected draft, or EmptyDetail with create prompts. Supports create blank, create from template, fork community, search, risk filter, delete drafts.

sections.name: Market() — Main Screen
sections.description: MasterDetail with strategies collapse key. Manages drafts state (localStorage persisted), community strategy listing, template system. List header has +New/+Template buttons and search input. List body shows Your drafts group + Community group with risk filter. Detail body is BuilderWorkspace (full-bleed).

sections.name: Draft Management
sections.description: Create, fork, search, filter, delete drafts. localStorage persistence. Templates: blank, leverage (5 nodes), deltaNeutral (4 nodes), rebalance (3 nodes). Fork creates a copy from template linked to community author.

sections.name: EmptyDetail
sections.description: Empty state shown when no draft selected. Prompts user to pick a draft, fork a template, or start blank with two CTAs.

files.name: screens/builder-workspace.jsx
files.description: Full strategy builder workspace with custom SVG canvas (not ReactFlow). 2106 lines. Features: node palette, drag-and-drop canvas, edge creation, pan/zoom, keyboard shortcuts (50+), simulation, issue detection, auto-organize layout, inline node config, undo/redo, copy/paste, multi-select, fullscreen, deploy progress, keyboard cheatsheet. This is the most complex forge file.

sections.name: NODE_TYPES / DEFAULT_CONFIG / TEMPLATES
sections.description: 5 node types: Supply, Borrow, Swap, Repeat, Settle. Each has label, kicker, swatch color, description. Default configs per type. 4 templates: blank, leverage (5 nodes, 4 edges), deltaNeutral (4 nodes, 3 edges), rebalance (3 nodes, 2 edges).

sections.name: BuilderWorkspace() — Main Component
sections.description: Core builder component with full state management: nodes, edges, selection, simulation, deploy, camera, pan/zoom, drag, multi-select, clipboard, undo/redo, idle pulse, issue detection, inline editor, cheatsheet, deploy toast.

sections.name: Canvas Engine
sections.description: Custom SVG canvas (not ReactFlow). Features: dotted grid background, three SVG edge layers (halo, stroke/hit, ports), configurable zoom layer (transform: translate + scale), node drag-and-drop with clientToWorld coordinate mapping, edge creation via port clicks, draw-on animation for new edges, marker arrowheads with severity colors.

sections.name: Pan & Zoom System
sections.description: Mouse wheel zoom (ctrl/cmd zooms around cursor, no-modifier pans), middle-mouse pan, shift+drag pan, space+drag pan (Figma-style), hand tool (H key) toggle, zoom controls overlay (+/−/reset%/fit/follow), canvas-zoom-layer transform with transition. Scale range: 0.4–2.2.

sections.name: Keyboard Shortcuts (50+)
sections.description: Full keyboard shortcut layer: 1-5 quick node add, Tab/⇧Tab cycle selection, Arrow keys nudge (⇧×8), Delete/Backspace delete, ⌘Z/⌘⇧Z undo/redo, ⌘C/⌘V copy/paste, ⌘D duplicate, ⌘A select all, S simulate, O organize, F fullscreen, I inspector toggle, H hand tool, V select tool, R reset, ? cheatsheet, ⌘B list toggle, ⌘0 reset zoom, Shift+1 fit all, Shift+2 fit selection, Esc cancel, ⌘+/⌘- zoom, Enter inline config. J/K vim navigation (in MasterDetail).

sections.name: Node Palette
sections.description: Left sidebar with 5 draggable node types. Each shows swatch color, label, tooltip with description. Drag-and-drop onto canvas triggers copy event. Supports canvas drop detection with highlight state. Items: Supply, Borrow, Swap, Repeat, Settle.

sections.name: Edge System
sections.description: Connection port system (input left, output right). Click output port starts pending edge, click input port completes connection. Cubic bezier path routing with backward-edge support. Edge selection (click on hit area), edge inspector popover (from/to types, gas estimate, delete). Edge severity classes: idle (dashed), active, selected, error (dashed/danger), warning (dashed/accent). Marker arrowheads per severity.

sections.name: Simulation Engine
sections.description: Topological walk simulation (walkOrder). Sequential step highlighting through runOrder with timeout-based progression (280ms + 520ms per step). Camera auto-follow with cameraLock toggle. Pre-sim view save/restore. Node state classes: active (pulsing), past (green checkmark). Edge active state with animated dot.

sections.name: Issue Detection Engine
sections.description: 4 detection rules: cycle outside Repeat (DFS, error), dead-end nodes (warn), missing Settle node (warn), incoherent borrow→settle (warn), consecutive swap merge tip (gas savings). Edge severity mapping. Suggestion pills on orphan nodes for next-step recommendation. Auto-fix: merge-swaps action. Issue pins floating near problem nodes. IssuesPanel with severity and apply button.

sections.name: Auto-Organize Layout
sections.description: Width-aware layered layout algorithm: computes ranks via longest path, Sugiyama median heuristic for edge-crossing reduction, bucket-based column/row spacing, center-aligned per rank. Supports canvas width/height parameters.

sections.name: Undo / Redo System
sections.description: History stack (max 50) with debounced snapshot push. Past/future arrays. Keyboard shortcuts ⌘Z/⌘⇧Z and toolbar buttons. Snapshots capture full nodes+edges state.

sections.name: Multi-Select & Clipboard
sections.description: ⌘+click for additive selection. ⌘A select all. ⌘D duplicate with offset. ⌘C/⌘V copy/paste with clipboard ref. Multi-selection drag moves all selected nodes together.

sections.name: Inline Node Config
sections.description: Click-to-edit overlay near node. Shows node config form with asset selectors, amount inputs, LTV slider, slippage, loop depth depending on type. Supports per-link allocation percentages when multiple outbound edges. Backdrop blur overlay. Positioned with screen-coordinate projection and right-overflow flips.

sections.name: Toolbar & Status Bar
sections.description: Top toolbar: draft name (editable), saved indicator (auto-save to localStorage), undo/redo, overflow menu (fullscreen, keyboard shortcuts), organize, delete, simulate, deploy buttons. Status bar: step/link count, estimated gas, permit/pending status indicator.

sections.name: Deploy Flow
sections.description: Deploy button triggers simulated deployment. DeployProgressModal shows progressive step-through with status (signing→confirmed→reverted). DeployToast shows success (tx hash, block) or error (message, retry). Auto-dismiss success after 6s.

sections.name: Template System
sections.description: 4 built-in templates: Blank (1 settle node), Leverage (5 nodes: supply→borrow→swap→repeat→settle), Delta-Neutral (4 nodes: supply→borrow→swap→settle), Auto-Rebalance (3 nodes: supply→repeat→settle). Each has nodes with positions, configs, and edge connections. Fork community creates from template linked to author.

sections.name: BuilderNode Component
sections.description: Renderer for individual canvas nodes. Displays header (swatch, label, status), body (asset/amount/LTV/swap config depending on type), input port (left, circle), output port (right, circle with active/pending states). CSS classes for selected, active, past, cycle, dragging states. Box-shadow style with brand aesthetic.

sections.name: Additional Builder Components
sections.description: KeyboardCheatsheet overlay (28 shortcuts in 3 groups: Canvas, Editing, Workflow), IssuePin floating annotations, EdgePopover inline inspector, SuggestionPill for orphan nodes, DeployProgressModal, DeployToast, AutoFixModal, ToolbarOverflow menu, NodeConfig form, IssuesPanel, PlainSummary code view, SavedIndicator, CanvasEmpty empty state, NodePalette, Inspector (config/issues/code tabs).

files.name: screens/governance.jsx
files.description: Governance screen with master-detail layout. Left rail: proposals grouped by status (Active, Queued, Executed, Defeated). Right pane: selected proposal detail with tally bar, quorum meter, metadata, and voting panel. 5 proposals total.

sections.description: MasterDetail with governance collapse key. 4 groups (Active 2, Queued 1, Executed 1, Defeated 1). Each list item shows status tag, title, time left, vote tally mini-bar. Detail shows ProposalDetail for selected.

sections.name: ProposalDetail

Cast vote panel for active proposals: 3-button selector (for/against/abstain), voting weight display, submit button. Disabled state when wallet not connected.

files.name: screens/connect-modal.jsx
files.description: 4-step wallet connect flow displayed as a modal overlay. Steps: Step 0 (Pick wallet: MetaMask/Rabby/WalletConnect/Ledger), Step 1 (Sign message to prove ownership), Step 2 (Grant 15-min CoFHE permit), Step 3 (Ready state with auto-dismiss). SessionStorage persistence for mid-flow refresh resilience.

sections.name: ConnectModal() — Main Component
sections.description: Modal-based connect flow. 4 stepper steps with dot indicators. Session state persists to sessionStorage for refresh resilience. Auto-dismisses 1.6s after step 4. Context sync on open. Step progression: wallet pick → sign → permit → ready.

sections.name: StepWallet
sections.description: Wallet selection grid (2×2: MetaMask, Rabby, WalletConnect, Ledger). Shows name, subtitle, selection indicator. Continue button advances to sign step.

k.description: Wallet key: metamask, rabby, wc, ledger

sections.name: StepSign
sections.description: Sign message prompt showing EIP-191 sign message preview (address, nonce, chain). Back/Sign buttons. Simulates wallet signature, then sets connected state.

sections.name: StepPermit
sections.description: Permit grant explanation with scope (your handles), expiry (15 minutes), cost (0 gas). Grant permit button triggers CoFHE permit. Back button to return to sign step.

sections.name: StepReady
sections.description: Ready confirmation with 'permit live' tag, success message ('You can read your numbers.'), animated pulse line, auto-dismisses after 1.6s.

files.name: tweaks-panel.jsx
files.description: Development tweaks panel with floating shell, drag-to-move, protocol-based host communication (postMessage for __activate/deactivate/edit_mode), and 9 reusable form controls (useTweaks, TweaksPanel, TweakSection, TweakRow, TweakSlider, TweakToggle, TweakRadio, TweakSelect, TweakText, TweakNumber, TweakColor, TweakButton). Used in app.jsx for theme switching, wallet state simulation, and route navigation.

sections.name: TweaksPanel Shell
sections.description: Floating panel positioned bottom-right, draggable, with backdrop-filter blur. Registers host protocol listener before announcing availability (postMessage __edit_mode_available). Close button posts __edit_mode_dismissed. ResizeObserver for viewport clamping. CSS-in-JS via __TWEAKS_STYLE string.

sections.name: useTweaks Hook
sections.description: Single source of truth for tweak values. setTweak persists via host protocol (postMessage __edit_mode_set_keys). Supports setTweak('key', value) or setTweak({key: value, ...}). Dispatches custom 'tweakchange' event for same-window listeners.

sections.name: TweakSection / TweakRow
sections.description: Layout helpers: section divider with label, row with optional value display (can be inline).

sections.name: TweakSlider
sections.description: Range slider with label and current value display.

sections.name: TweakToggle
sections.description: iOS-style toggle switch with data-on attribute transition.

sections.name: TweakRadio
sections.description: Segmented control for 2-3 short options. Auto-falls back to TweakSelect when options are too long (>16/10 chars per option). Pointer-drag for fast switching on segment track. Custom thumb with animated transitions.

sections.name: TweakSelect
sections.description: Native select dropdown.

sections.name: TweakText / TweakNumber
sections.description: Text input and number input with scrub-to-change label (pointer drag horizontal to adjust value). Clamp support.

sections.name: TweakColor
sections.description: Curated color/palette picker. Each option is a hex string or array of 1-5 hex strings (palette card). Renders hero color (~2/3) with stacked rest on right. SVG checkmark with contrast-aware fill. Falls back to native color input when no options provided.
props: options? (array of hex strings or arrays)

sections.name: TweakButton
sections.description: Action button with primary/secondary styles.

sections.name: App.jsx Usage of TweaksPanel
sections.description: Used in App() for: Theme section (light/dark radio, paper grain toggle), Prototype state section (wallet connected toggle, permit granted toggle), Jump to section (route navigation buttons: Home, Folio, Lend, Build, Gov, Connect).
